hero.title: The science of endurance
hero.lead: Told by those who measure it. Race data, physiology, strategy, athlete preparation: our experts bring to the stage what they see every day.
hero.audiences: Sports events · Companies · Schools and universities
hero.alt: Joseph Mestrallet giving a talk in front of an auditorium

joseph.text: The face of Enduraw, Joseph shares his vision of endurance performance at the crossroads of data, science and the field. An engineer by training, he speaks to athletes as well as executives, students and corporate teams.
joseph.alt: Joseph Mestrallet at the microphone during a talk
joseph.stat2Label: per talk, depending on the format

themes.title: Topics rooted in the field
themes.lead: Six topics, tailored to your audience's level and expectations.
themes.alt: Talk on the physiology of endurance effort in front of a screen

t1.title: Data and performance
t1.text: What data really reveals about running and trail performance, and how to read it.

t2.title: Physiology and testing
t2.text: VO₂max, thresholds, lactate: what tests measure and how they guide training.

t3.title: Pacing and race strategy
t3.text: Managing pace, effort and nutrition to reach your full potential on race day.

t4.title: Behind the scenes of elite sport
t4.text: Analyses of major races and lessons from supporting elite athletes.

t5.title: Performance and business
t5.text: What endurance sport teaches about commitment, consistency and managing effort at work.

t6.title: Data and storytelling
t6.text: How numbers enrich the story of a race for media, brands and organisers.

experts.title: Enduraw experts
experts.text: Our experts work every day with athletes, brands and race organisers. They take the stage to share this experience, with an accessible, data-backed message.
experts.altJoseph: Joseph Mestrallet on stage for the talk “Secrets de compétition”
experts.altValentin: Race data presented on a large screen
